text:
Let me know, Love, where you pasture,

where you guide your flocks, where you wander,

lest I tread after the ill-fated islands

the ashen routes of evening.


Your flock, O tender Love, where do you sustain it

and delight it with richest pastures,

while you threaten my clumsy heart

with long paths and slow hours?


Let me not begin to follow the shepherds'

scattered flocks. My life,

show, far away, the sun of your loves;


tell me where you pasture still!,

and I will follow your trace among the flowers,

through the fires of golden noon.

translation.title: Let Me Know, Love, Where You Pasture...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps this variant's floral closing distinct from the related Shulamite song.
